Odoo ERP Implementation — Procera Gin

ERP Solutions Architect Procera Gin Jan 2025 – Dec 2025

Overview

End-to-end Odoo rollout for a gin manufacturer: discovery and process mapping across production, inventory and distribution, full-system configuration, data migration, user training and go-live support for the whole organisation.

Skills Used

Odoo ERP Implementation Process Mapping Data Migration User Training

The Challenge

Procera Gin was running production, inventory and distribution on spreadsheets and disconnected tools. Orders moved through more than 20 manual touchpoints, stock levels were only accurate at month-end, and management had no single view of the business.

What I Did

Discovery & process mapping

Ran structured interviews with production, warehouse, finance and distribution teams. Mapped the full order-to-distribution workflow and identified where handoffs failed and records were duplicated.

System design & configuration

Configured Odoo across manufacturing, inventory, purchasing, sales and accounting. Set up multi-step routes so goods move through the system the same way they move through the building, and aligned tax and journal structures with the finance team.

Data migration

Cleaned and loaded item masters, opening stock, supplier and customer records, with validation counts agreed with each department before cutover.

Training & go-live

Ran role-based training for warehouse and office users, supported users through the first stock takes and closing cycles, and stayed on for post-go-live refinements.

Outcome

  • One connected system replacing spreadsheets across the organisation
  • Order-to-distribution flow mapped and digitised across 20+ touchpoints
  • Accurate, always-on stock visibility for production and sales teams
  • Users adopted the system through role-based training and floor support
